dcterms:description: A collection of 570k human-written English sentence pairs supporting the task of natural language inference. The task is to predict whether the premise entails, contradicts, or is neutral with respect to the hypothesis.

dcterms:description: A crowd-sourced collection of 433k sentence pairs annotated with textual entailment information, covering a range of genres including transcribed speech, fiction, and government reports.
dcterms:title: Multi-Genre Natural Language Inference (MNLI) Corpus

dcterms:description: A dataset converted from the Stanford Question Answering Dataset (SQuAD), consisting of question-paragraph pairs where one of the sentences in the paragraph contains the answer to the corresponding question.
dcterms:title: Question-answering Natural Language Inference (QNLI)
